name: clean-model-names
goal: Shared type-only models keep their identities and use clean names across cards, usage links and detail headings.

evidence: Keep shared models with clean PascalCase names; preserve IDs, type filenames and classification. The selected model naming helper currently returns Deployment.types from its owned source.

The standard explorer-name matrix explicitly expected Order.types. Existing browser cards only used runtime Order.ts. Extend that matrix and shared mixed-consumer fixture with a type collection and values companion; retain card, usage and detail checks at current and historical revisions. Generated instructions lacked logical model naming guidance.
